login.title: Welcome to Chatick
login.subtitle: Sign in to open your project workspace

start.companySubtitle: A company holds your projects and your team
start.projectSubtitle: Choose a project or create a new one

llm.title: AI provider (LLM)
llm.subtitle: Connect your company's own LLM key — it powers all AI features across projects
llm.notConfigured: Not connected yet — AI features are disabled
llm.keyKeep: Enter a new key to replace the current one
llm.keyNote: The key is stored encrypted (AES-256-GCM) and is never shown again.
llm.disconnectConfirm: Disconnect the LLM? AI features will stop working.

projectForm.improveTasksHint: New tasks are translated into the project language and lightly polished — meaning unchanged
projectForm.storageLimitHint: Overrides the company's shared quota for this project
projectForm.name: Name
projectForm.rulesHint: Shown to every member before joining and included in every AI request — keep it to a couple of sentences.
projectForm.rulesPlaceholder: E.g.: Work topics only. Statuses go to tasks, not the chat. English or Russian.
projectForm.aiSubtitle: What the AI does with messages in this chat
projectForm.languageHint: The canonical language of this chat
projectForm.autoTranslateHint: Translate messages into each reader's language
projectForm.answerRepeatsHint: If the answer already exists, the AI replies instead of pinging people

observer.title: Observer
observer.desc: Only translates and answers when asked directly

assistant.title: Assistant
assistant.desc: Also answers from context and suggests actions

moderator.title: Moderator
moderator.desc: Also holds unclear messages, duplicates and off-topic

tasks.newPlaceholder: New task — type a title and press Enter
tasks.attachHint: Drag files here or click Attach

files.dropHint: Drag files here or use the Upload button

viewer.noPreview: No preview available for this file type

perms.title: Permissions
perms.subtitle: What each member can do — in the UI and via the AI in chat

write.label: Write
write.hint: View, create and edit (delete own only)

crud.label: Full
crud.hint: Full access, including deleting others' items

perms.aiNote: The AI dispatcher respects these permissions: a member with Read-only can't create tasks through chat either. Secret values are never shared with the AI.

resources.note: A resource is a link + description with optional secrets. The AI can save links/credentials shared in chat here automatically.

creds.valueKeepPlaceholder: New value (leave empty to keep current)
creds.securityNote: Values are stored encrypted (AES-256-GCM). Every reveal and copy is recorded in the audit log. Values are never shared with the AI.

rules.title: Rules of “{{project}}”
rules.empty: No special rules — be respectful and stay on topic.

chat.noLlmText: The chat runs on the AI dispatcher. Connect your company's LLM provider to start messaging.
chat.noLlmPlaceholder: Connect an LLM to start chatting…
chat.groupHint: Group messages — routed through the AI dispatcher
chat.aiHint: Private conversation with the project AI
chat.rawSendHint: Skip the AI check — marked as unverified
chat.redirectedToAi: Your question to the AI moved to the private AI channel

aiChannel.title: AI channel
aiChannel.subtitle: Private conversation with the project AI — others don't see it
aiChannel.clearNote: The AI's context starts fresh — the group chat is not affected.

sandbox.title: Message review
sandbox.subtitle: The AI held your message — sort it out here privately, nobody else sees this
sandbox.forceNote: The message will appear in the chat with an “unverified” badge.

projTeam.title: Project team
projTeam.subtitle: Members, invitations and permissions of this project
projTeam.added: Member added — a notification email was sent
projTeam.addNote: Members are added without confirmation; they receive an email afterwards.
projTeam.nobodyToAdd: Everyone from the company is already in the project
projTeam.removeNote: They will receive a notification email.
